name: Sampling & Temperature
question: How does a model pick its next word, and what does temperature change?
problem: Send the same prompt twice and you get two different answers. The model scores every word in its vocabulary, then samples one.
points: Softmax turns the raw scores (logits) into probabilities that add up to 1.
Temperature divides the logits first: low sharpens the top choice, high flattens the curve.
Top-p keeps only the smallest set of words covering p of the probability, so a high temperature doesn't pick nonsense.
title: How LLMs Actually Choose Words: Sampling & Temperature Explained #shorts
